verdicts.note: Speaks throughout as a woman (marriage/flying, 'ladies', 'girls'); study is of women students. Supports female.
'No' to girls'/private school + 'normal Catholic school' reasonably implies mixed sex; inferential but sound.
'always wanted to work in planes... they just fascinate me' = strong draw of interesting work; supports 5.
Values course breadth, but this is retrospective ('at first not happy'), not an initial draw; thin for an attraction item, downgrade.
'did it all on my own', school had no info; father in construction not her field. Disagree fits.
'Did it all on my own' is about course INFO, not encouragement. Parents 'pushed me forward' and A-level tutor helped, so 'nobody encouraged' is contradicted; should be disagree.
Cultural norm 'girls not allowed to travel' is a generalized discouraging backdrop, but no named person and parents supported her; keep yes at low confidence.
Attributes to 'our culture', not a family member; her family (parents) actively supported her, so 'other family' is contradicted. Best fit is 8=other (cultural).
'I have no doubts... I am happy' is explicit strong agreement; supports 5.
'I like the fact they've done it like that. It's really good' = satisfied with subject variety.
'personal tutor has really helped me greatly', biggest influence, approachable; supports very satisfied.
'really good mate... helped me so much... improved by 10%' = strongly positive on friends/support made on course.
'this year we're alright... taken it really seriously' (one freeloader group aside); net mildly positive = satisfied.
Names 50/50 coursework/exams as 'the best bit'; supports agree the balance is just right (slight 'rather more coursework' caveat).
'No, because I decided not to do it' = not going on placement.
'wrote about 60 letters... they're all nos' = applied extensively but not accepted; supports strongly agree.
Wanted abroad/out of London but all rejected; location-specific failure partly overlaps with general rejection, but quote supports agree.
'my mates... not going on placement' is a non-listed additional reason = other (8).
'sit in the office and actually manage the airport' = clear managerial preference.
'getting things sorted and having them working in proper order' / manage the airport; project management is the closest available listed option (no clean fit).
